title: BattINFO publisher prefix register
description: The shape of prefixes.json. That numbers are unique and given out in sequence from 1000 is checked by battinfo.namespace when it loads the file.

prefix.description: The publisher's number: four or more digits, written as a string.

holder.description: The minting authority the number was given to.

records.description: Whether records are minted under id/{prefix}/. False for a prefix that holds definitions only.

records_rdf.description: Where the RDF of a record minted under this prefix lives, as a record pattern, or null.

records_page.description: Where the human page of a record minted under this prefix lives, as a record pattern, or null.

allocated.description: The date the number was given out (YYYY-MM-DD).

allOf.description: A prefix that holds definitions only has no records, so neither pattern.
1001 is the Battery Genome registry's, which serves its records itself.

recordPattern.description: An https URL template on a fixed host, in which {uid} stands for the record's uid and {segment}, which is optional, for its segment, such as cell. It has {uid} and no other placeholder. Null for a prefix that holds definitions only, for 1001, and for a holder that serves no records by uid.
